crm_notes:
Summary: Argentum Reserve is an institutional wealth-tech platform; primary goal is predictable, low-latency inference for customer-facing chat and batch reranking for downstream analytics. They view Dedicated as the only acceptable path due to data residency and encryption-in-use requirements.

POC scope (agreed):
- Functional: feature parity for chat flows with existing hosted provider (tool calls, streaming).
- Perf: load and soak tests to validate throughput guarantees and p95/p99 latency SLOs.
- Ops: prove node sizing and autoscale policies under steady + burst traffic, KMS integration, audit log delivery.

Performance targets (Argentum stated):
- Chat (interactive): p95 < 120ms token latency under normal load; p99 < 300ms; burst handling up to 600 qps for 60s windows without >20% latency regressions.
- Reranking (batch): sustained throughput of ~1800 inference requests/minute (small prompts), need predictable QPS over 6-hour windows.
- Soak: 72-hour steady-state run at 70% planned capacity to validate thermal throttling / KV cache behavior.

Reserved GPU planning notes:
- Preliminary sizing request: equivalent of 8x H100 (or 16x A100-80GB depending on availability) to meet peak demands with headroom for redundancy. Interested in being prescriptive about per-GPU model variants and quantized builds.
- Wants explicit fallback policy in SLA: if Dedicated pool unavailable, traffic can route to a lower-cost compatible variant in same region with controls and rate limits.

POC test plan (Redwood + Argentum joint):
- Test harness: Redwood to deliver JMeter-like harness + streaming client; repo stub: github.com/redwood/poc-harness/argentum (stub link).
acceptance_criteria: Sustained 72h soak with p95 <= 120ms for chat at agreed load profile
Throughput guarantees validated: sustained QPS targets with <5% error rate
KV/prefix cache cutover tested (cache hit rate > 60% for chat sequences)
KMS integration exercised end-to-end + audit events verified
SLA draft updated to include explicit latency SLOs, incident routing, RTO/RPO for Dedicated pool
